newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cemex started at buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities started Mexican cement leader Cemex as a buy at a price of 32.30 pesos. Analysts Paul Rodriguez and Damon Palmer said its B shares are trading at a deep discount to its Mexican peers and at a historically low premium to its multinational peers.
-- Said 12-month price target is 51.37 pesos per share ($11.46 per ADS) representing a 60 percent nominal peso return (35 percent in dollars), including a 0.9 percent dividend.
-- Says Cemex is oppportunity to take part in Mexico's economic recovery and growth in cement demand, margin improvements, and consolidation of operations in Colombia.
